description: Increase the reward for a marketplace task. Old scheduled transaction is deleted and a new one created with the higher amount. Task must be in posted or claimed status. Returns { taskId, newScheduleId, newPriceHbar, hcsTxId }.

newPriceHbar.description: New reward amount in HBAR (must be greater than current)

taskId.description: Task ID to increase reward for
